notes: No human person is named: no scribe, commissioner, king, or owner. 'vālmīkīye' occurs only as part of the standard title formula (ārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye) and is not recorded as a person; the commentator of the Rāmāyaṇatilaka (Nāgeśa Bhaṭṭa/Rāmavarman) is not named. Four-digit saṃvat 1847 in a Devanagari manuscript taken as Vikrama Saṃvat (≈ 1790 CE); 'miti' and the date formula point to a late Nepalese/North Indian context. Catalogue 'Samvat 1847' agrees with the colophon. Folio references in the quotation are inconsistent (190r7, 190r1, 190r13) but do not affect the extraction.
